paper.title: Fully sequential Gaussian process regression for preference learning

settings.name_in_paper: Global optimization with noisy pairwise comparisons (preference learning) with GP moment-matching updates
unmapped: Feedback is the sign of f(z1)-f(z2)+xi with Gaussian noise xi ~ N(0, sigma^2) (probit preference model)
f - mu^0 - c_* lies in the RKHS of prior kernel Sigma^0 for some constant c_* (Assumption 5.1)
Approximation width W_r^2 = O(r^{-a}) for some a > 1 (Assumption 5.2)
Design space compact convex subset of R^d; f deterministic and continuous
settings.definition_quote: we may choose two design points $x,x'\in\mathcal{X}$ and make a noisy observation of only the \textit{sign} of $f\left(x\right) - f\left(x'\right)$... $s^{n+1} = \sgn\left(f\left(z^n_1\right)-f\left(z^n_2\right)+\xi^{n+1}\right)$ ... where $\xi^{n+1}\sim\mathcal{N}\left(0,\sigma^2\right)$

symbols.a: exponent of the kernel approximation width, W_r^2 = O(r^{-a}), a > 1

conditions: Assumption 3.1: compact convex design space in R^d, f continuous, Sigma^0 continuous PSD with strict Cauchy-Schwarz
Assumption 5.1: f - mu^0 - c_* in RKHS of Sigma^0
tuning: proposal satisfies B^n >= chi * sup B^n for fixed chi in (0,1)
randomized bridge with rho^n = diam/sqrt(log(n+e)), Lambda^n = log log(n+e^e)

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Suppose that we are in the situation of Theorem \ref{thm:consistency}. Let $\hat{x}^n$ be an $\mathcal{F}^n$-measurable element of $\arg\max_{x\in\mathcal{X}} \mu^n\left(x\right)$. Then, there exists a deterministic $N_1$ such that $\mathbb{E}\left(\max_{x\in\mathcal{X}}f\left(x\right) - f\left(\hat{x}^n\right)\right) = O\left(\sqrt{\log n}\cdot n^{-\frac{a-1}{2\left(a+1\right)}}\right)$ for $n \geq N_1$.

results.notes: Expected simple regret of recommendation argmax mu^n after n comparisons (T = n). Constants depend on f, Sigma^0, sigma. For Matern kernel with nu > d/2, a = 2nu/d giving O(n^{-(nu-d/2)/(2nu+d)} (log n)^{1/2}). Frequentist analysis with f deterministic.

bound.regime: for every eps > 0, as n -> infinity

symbols.a: exponent of the kernel approximation width, W_r^2 = O(r^{-a}), a > 1

tuning: proposal satisfies B^n >= chi * sup B^n for fixed chi in (0,1)

source.label: thm:consistency
source.quote: Let Assumptions \ref{a1}, \ref{a3} and \ref{a4} hold, and suppose that $\left(z^n_1,z^n_2\right)$ is determined using the DOVE policy... Then, for every $\varepsilon > 0$, $\sup_{x,x'\in\mathcal{X}}\left|\ell_{x,x'}\Delta^n\right|^2 = o\left(\left(\log n\right)^{2+\varepsilon} n^{-\frac{a-1}{a+1}}\right)$ almost surely.

results.notes: Quantity is the squared uniform error of estimated pairwise differences sup |mu^n(x)-mu^n(x') - (f(x)-f(x'))|^2. Paper states little-o; recorded with notation O.

cited_results.setting_description: Classical GP regression / Bayesian optimization with direct (Gaussian) function evaluations, Matern kernel with smoothness nu, dimension d; simple regret
